test_run_interrupt: test the run_interrupt_test.py script to verify parent AIAgent interrupt propagates to delegate child threads
run_delegate_child: run a delegate child agent via _run_single_child with a slow mock OpenAI client and patched AIAgent init
create_agent_with_budget: create an AIAgent instance with IterationBudget(max_total=100) for thread-safe iteration limiting
interrupt_agent: interrupt a running AIAgent via parent.interrupt(message) to signal all active children and tools to abort
set_global_interrupt: set global interrupt state via set_interrupt(True/False) and check with is_interrupted() for per-thread interrupt tracking
